note: Ceiling of the published stylesheet (dist/styles.css): raw bytes, gzip level 9 and brotli. Growth fails; a drop wider than the slack is recorded with `pnpm ui-cli update css`; raising a ceiling is a reviewed edit of this file with its reason. Lowered when the artifact dropped to a single spelling (spec 158, #164): every utility is declared once, as its `pui:` class, and no longer also as a bare twin, so the sheet is 103353 raw bytes smaller than the doubled emission it replaces. Raised by 40 raw bytes (gzip and brotli both shrank) when the token contract moved into `@layer pagopa-ui.base` behind `:where(.pagopa-ui-root)`: the wrapper and the zero-specificity selector are the bytes, and the layer is what lets a host layer override a `--pui-*` value. Raised by 119 raw bytes (gzip and brotli both shrank) when the components stopped sizing the library glyphs in their own DOM: `:not(.pagopa-icon)` on 36 host selectors absolves a call site's `size` from a component default, and the pseudo-class is the bytes (spec 158, #170). Raised to 136498 raw bytes, the size the artifact now measures (gzip and brotli stay under their ceilings), when the two unpublished state steps became `color-mix` derivations of their endpoints instead of hand-picked hexes: each `--pui-*` declaration names both references, so the built sheet carries a base-step fallback plus the composite, and the contract resolves and publishes the colour it computes (#191). Raised to 137399 raw bytes (gzip and brotli both shrank) when keyboard focus became the library outline on Badge, Accordion, PinPoint, the contrast Button and the carousel stepper's 24px targets: the outline utilities are new classes, and the badge's destructive variant moved from translucent ring colours to the opaque ratified error tokens (#207).
